newsitem.title: USA: Cadmus says will take Q4 charge.
newsitem.headline: Cadmus says will take Q4 charge.

text.p: Cadmus Communications Corp said Wednesday it will take a pre-tax restructuring charge in the range of $17.5 million to $19.5 million in its fourth quarter ending June 30, 1997.
The company said the charge is $1.35 to $1.50 per share after tax.
The Company estimates that cash outlays associated with the restructuring and realignment charge will be about $6 million, which will be incurred in calendar 1997.
The company said the rest of the restructuring charge relates to non-cash items, mainly the write-down of certain operating assets, goodwill and other intangibles.
The company said it will restructure its marketing and magazine businesses, close certain facilities, and write-down certain equipment, investments in non-core businesses, and intangible assets.
